headline: Approved $261,373 service truck and three waste collection vehicles for $1,099,888.11; re-referred Allegiance Fire & Rescue contract to Finance Committee.
summary: Adopted a resolution amending a Harbor Homes housing grant agreement for non-veterans and their families. Approved a joint committee on infrastructure and the Fire Commission. Also received a memo on prepaying $1,240,610 for a Fire Rescue air supply unit.
decisions: Accepted and placed on file a memo on prepaying $1,240,610 for a Fire Rescue air supply unit.
Approved the Board of Fire Commissioners request to convene a joint committee on infrastructure and the Fire Commission, 14-0.
Re-referred the Allegiance Fire & Rescue contract to the Finance Committee, 14-0.
Approved the purchase of one 2026 Kenworth T280 service truck from New England Kenworth for up to $261,373, 12-2.
Approved the purchase of three waste collection vehicles from Sanitary Equipment for up to $1,099,888.11, 12-2.
Referred three mayoral appointments to the Personnel/Administrative Affairs Committee.
Accepted and placed on file Budget Review Committee reports from October 2026.
Adopted Resolution R-26-080 on final passage, 13 yea, 0 nay, 1 abstention.
Referred Resolution R-26-081 to the Budget Review Committee after its first reading.

A regular meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at 8:24 p.m. in the aldermanic 
chamber, and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91-
A:2 II. 
  
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Dan Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Dan Healey; Alderwoman-at-Large Shoshanna Kelly led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.  
 
The roll call was taken with 14 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons,  
Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg (via 
Zoom), Alderman Dowd (via Zoom), Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly, 
Alderman Morgan, Alderman Wilshire.    
     
Alderman Lopez was recorded absent.   
 
Mayor James W. Donchess and Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton were also in attendance.
